svg.text: Source-derived measurement plan with actual Unity Editor capsule routes. Units: metres. Not a screenshot.
Bath / kitchen / balcony are overlays, not additions.
External platform: 8.06 m², excluded from dwelling.
Wall projection: source mesh, not a screenshot.
Dark walls: solid section at Y=1.0 m.
Pale walls: full projection, including overhead lintels.
Blue edges: fixed window glazing, not open passages.
Widths: reviewed baseline / actual Unity motion.
S sofa A armchair T coffee table V TV unit
DT dining table D1–D4 dining chairs
BT balcony table B1–B3 balcony chairs
Green outline: rug. Orange dashed: baseline hull.
Hulls are visual vertex projections, not free space.
Purple: Living Room → Balcony front edge
All three reached their exact requested goals.
Capsule r=0.30 m, height=1.8 m, foot lift=0.025 m.
Doors opened with their real AdvanceMotion API.
Dashed circle is a scaled r=0.30 m footprint.
Not Quest / Player / participant evaluation evidence.
Not HK building, fire or accessibility certification.
No guarantee for every player height or bag orientation.
0.90 m route goal is not certified by these paths.
Final model still needs hardware regression.
X east/right and Z north/up. Scale is 82 pixels per metre. Projection excludes door-leaf drawings; widths refer to fully opened leaves.
Sources: Offline-Before.json, Offline-Final.json, Unity-Route-Final.json, Door-Apply-Checks.txt. Week 8 developer stabilization only.
Actual Unity-tested geometry SHA: 412911e. Saved 23a9813 differs only by 11 empty m_Name trailing spaces; semantic comparison verified.
